name: Hashimoto Yasuo
source: Company employee. 52 years old. With a calm and friendly personality, is well-liked not only by colleagues but also by superiors and subordinates, and was promoted smoothly up to the position of deputy department head. Has a personal life plan mapped out, and steadily advances step by step according to that plan. Hobby is shogi.
